title: Netting Units on Hand Against the Remaining Span on Extension, Referrals and Authorizations
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, units already on hand are netted against the span when an approved authorization is extended.

## Definitions

- **Days left on the authorization**: the units granted plus the units added, less the units used, read from its unit history.
- **Span days still ahead**: the days from today through the span's last day, counting today.

## Clause

1. Where the days left exceed the span days still ahead, the excess is **taken off** the extension.
2. Where they fall short of the span days still ahead, the shortfall is **added, rounded up to a whole number of the type's concurrent review intervals**, or **added as it stands** where the type sets no concurrent review interval.
3. Otherwise nothing changes.

## Concurrent review intervals (calendar days)

| Authorization type | Interval |
|---|---|
| Specialty Care Referral | 0 (no concurrent review) |
| Rehabilitative Therapy Referral | 0 (no concurrent review) |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | 0 (no concurrent review) |
| Home Health Care Authorization | 60 |
| Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization | 0 (no concurrent review) |
| Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization | 14 |
| Inpatient Mental Health Authorization | 3 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical; Inpatient Mental Health Authorization, interval 3 days, span ending 10 May)

| Today | Span days ahead | Days left | Effect on the extension |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8 May | 3 | 5 | 2 days taken off |
| 6 May | 5 | 1 | 4 short, rounded up to 6, so 6 days added |
| 8 May | 3 | 3 | none |

For a type whose interval is 0, such as the Rehabilitative Therapy Referral, a shortfall of 4 days is added as it stands: 4 days (hypothetical).
